property_summary: owner() must always return the stored owner set at initialization regardless of who calls it; the bug makes owner() return msg.sender, so a caller other than the stored owner observes a different address.
owner() must be caller-independent: calling owner() from any two distinct accounts yields the same value; the bug makes owner() return msg.sender, so two distinct callers observe different values.

For any nonzero address accepted through the two-step ownership transfer (initiated from the zero-address current owner), owner() must return that accepted address; the mutant always returns address(0) and thus breaks this for every admissible newOwner.
